AcceptanceTrace.description:
Where the plan checks one acceptance line of a requirement (field run 2, R2-18: a P1 naming rule never reached
the plan, and every gate passed). Exactly one of: an expectation step, a `forbidden_text` entry, a check a later
node runs, or the reason it is out of scope for this prototype.
AcceptanceTrace.title: AcceptanceTrace

ClaimedFixed.description: Reviews asked to re-verify a deferred defect said it no longer holds, and no current review reports it (W61).
ClaimedFixed.title: ClaimedFixed

FocusTrace.description:
Where the plan checks one of N08's focus rules (backlog N-22: a build broke two and passed, because no scenario
checked them). Exactly one of: a scenario step that is an `expect_focus`, a browser check that covers the rule, or
the reason it is out of scope for this prototype.
FocusTrace.title: FocusTrace

LedgerBreak.description: A loss of ledger events that a named human accepted because no backup existed (`pdg accept-ledger-break`).
LedgerBreak.title: LedgerBreak

PassedChecks.description:
The code and the configuration a node's tool checks ran with when it passed: a later change to either is a check
upgrade its verdict never saw (field run W65).
PassedChecks.title: PassedChecks

Ratification.description: A named human confirms or reverses a delegated/transcribed action after the fact.
Ratification.title: Ratification

RiskAcceptance.description: A named human accepts building past an unvalidated riskiest assumption (`pdg accept-risk`).
RiskAcceptance.title: RiskAcceptance

ScenarioStep.description: One step of the browser scenario DSL executed by `pdg.tools.browser` (exactly one action per step).
ScenarioStep.title: ScenarioStep

StateRecover.description:
The way out of a state (R-UX-002: an empty state has a way back): the suite presses `click`, then expects the
state to be gone (backlog B-09: a "Clear filters" with no handler passed every check).
StateRecover.title: StateRecover
